title: Meditest
bottom_line: Market analysis projects 108,000 annual purchasers in the UK (10% of 1.08M diabetics), growing to 144,000 people with diabetes in 4 years. At projected 25% market share and falling price point (from £120 to £60), revenues would reach £2.16 million annually in 4 years. However, this revenue was deemed insufficient for company growth objectives, suggesting the need to expand geographically or adjust pricing/market positioning strategy.
